# GitLab

> GitLab is an AI-powered DevSecOps platform providing intelligent orchestration across the entire software lifecycle.

GitLab offers a comprehensive suite of tools for source code management, CI/CD automation, application security testing, and compliance management. The platform is designed for enterprises, small businesses, and public sector organizations seeking unified DevSecOps solutions with built-in AI capabilities through GitLab Duo.

## Key Topics

- DevSecOps Platform
- CI/CD Pipeline
- GitLab Duo (AI)
- Source Code Management
- Application Security Testing (SAST/DAST/SCA)
- Software Supply Chain Security
- Compliance Automation
- Value Stream Management
- DORA Metrics
- GitOps
- FedRAMP Compliance
- Enterprise Features
- AI Agents
- Software Delivery Automation
- Developer Productivity
